# Morning & Evening Adhkar (أذكار الصباح والمساء): full text

> The complete morning and evening adhkar from Aladhkaar (https://aladhkaar.com), each in Arabic with an English translation of the meaning, how many times to say it, and its source in the Quran or the hadith collections. Free to read, print and share. Please cite https://aladhkaar.com when you quote from this list.

Morning adhkar are said in the morning, from after Fajr; evening adhkar in the evening, from after Asr. Where the wording changes between morning and evening, both wordings are given.

To make a printable card with any of these adhkar, in your own order and design: https://aladhkaar.com/make
Ready-made printable card (PDF, A4): English https://aladhkaar.com/ready/aladhkaar-morning-evening.pdf · Arabic https://aladhkaar.com/ready/aladhkaar-morning-evening-ar.pdf

## 1. We have entered the morning upon the natural way …

Morning (Arabic): أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
Morning (meaning): We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, and he was not of the polytheists.

Evening (Arabic): أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
Evening (meaning): We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, and he was not of the polytheists.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Ahmad (أحمد)

## 2. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with …

Arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا.
Meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 3 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5072 (أبو داود ٥٠٧٢)

## 3. O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

When: Morning only · How many times: Once
Source: Ibn Majah 925 (ابن ماجه ٩٢٥)

## 4. O Allah, by You we enter the morning and …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ.
Meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

Evening (Arabic): اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
Evening (meaning): O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Abu Dawud 5068, at-Tirmidhi 3391 (أبو داود ٥٠٦٨، الترمذي ٣٣٩١)

## 5. In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing …

Arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
Meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 3 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5088, at-Tirmidhi 3388 (أبو داود ٥٠٨٨، الترمذي ٣٣٨٨)

## 6. Recite Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255).

Arabic: قِرَاءَةُ آيَةِ الْكُرْسِيِّ.
Meaning: Recite Ayat al-Kursi (Al-Baqarah 2:255).

Full text (Arabic): اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: an-Nasa'i (al-Kubra), al-Hakim (النسائي في الكبرى، الحاكم) · Quran

## 7. Recite Surat al-Ikhlas, Surat al-Falaq, and Surat an-Nas.

Arabic: سُورَةُ الْإِخْلَاصِ، سُورَةُ الْفَلَقِ، سُورَةُ النَّاسِ.
Meaning: Recite Surat al-Ikhlas, Surat al-Falaq, and Surat an-Nas.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 3 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5082, at-Tirmidhi 3575 (أبو داود ٥٠٨٢، الترمذي ٣٥٧٥) · Quran

## 8. Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god …

Arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
Meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 7 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5081 (أبو داود ٥٠٨١)

## 9. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner …

Arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
Meaning: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 10 times
Source: Ahmad, an-Nasa'i (al-Kubra) (أحمد، النسائي في الكبرى)

## 10. O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
Meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: al-Bukhari 6306 (البخاري ٦٣٠٦)

## 11. O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
Meaning: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself, from the evil of Satan and his call to shirk, and from bringing harm upon myself or upon a Muslim.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Abu Dawud 5067, at-Tirmidhi 3392 (أبو داود ٥٠٦٧، الترمذي ٣٣٩٢)

## 12. O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ، وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck down from beneath me.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Abu Dawud 5074, Ibn Majah 3871 (أبو داود ٥٠٧٤، ابن ماجه ٣٨٧١)

## 13. Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him …

Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
Meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

When: Morning only · How many times: 3 times
Source: Muslim 2726 (مسلم ٢٧٢٦)

## 14. O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
Meaning: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 3 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5090 (أبو داود ٥٠٩٠)

## 15. O Allah, this morning I call on You, the …

Morning (Arabic): اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
Morning (meaning): O Allah, this morning I call on You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.

Evening (Arabic): اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
Evening (meaning): O Allah, this evening I call on You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation to witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 4 times
Source: Abu Dawud 5069 (أبو داود ٥٠٦٩)

## 16. Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

Arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
Meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 100 times or more
Source: Muslim 2692 (مسلم ٢٦٩٢)

## 17. We have entered the morning and the dominion has …

Morning (Arabic): أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
Morning (meaning): We have entered the morning and the dominion has entered the morning belonging to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

Evening (Arabic): أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
Evening (meaning): We have entered the evening and the dominion has entered the evening belonging to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Muslim 2723 (مسلم ٢٧٢٣)

## 18. O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy …

Arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
Meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: an-Nasa'i (al-Kubra), al-Hakim (النسائي في الكبرى، الحاكم)

## 19. I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah …

Arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
Meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

When: Evening only · How many times: 3 times
Source: Muslim 2709 (مسلم ٢٧٠٩)

## 20. O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
Meaning: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 10 times
Source: at-Tabarani (الطبراني)

## 21. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I …

Arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ.
Meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: 3 times
Source: at-Tirmidhi 2572 (الترمذي ٢٥٧٢)

## 22. I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no …

Arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
Meaning: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all, and I turn to Him in repentance.

When: Morning and evening
Source: Abu Dawud 1517, at-Tirmidhi 3577 (أبو داود ١٥١٧، الترمذي ٣٥٧٧)

## 23. O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your …

Morning (Arabic): اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
Morning (meaning): O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this morning is from You alone, without partner, so to You is all praise and to You all thanks.

Evening (Arabic): اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
Evening (meaning): O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this evening is from You alone, without partner, so to You is all praise and to You all thanks.

When: Morning and evening · How many times: Once
Source: Abu Dawud 5073 (أبو داود ٥٠٧٣)

## On the virtue of remembering Allah

- فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
  So remember Me; I will remember you. Be grateful to Me and do not deny Me. (Al-Baqarah 2:152)
- وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
  Your Lord has said: Call upon Me; I will respond to you. (Ghafir 40:60)
- مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
  The example of one who remembers his Lord and one who does not is like that of the living and the dead. (Narrated by Abu Musa al-Ash'ari, Sahih al-Bukhari)
